card.title: How to fix iPhone 7 that does not turn on, hangs at 0.020–0.030 A after you prompt to boot on DC Power Supply

source.title: How to fix iPhone 7 that does not turn on, hangs at 0.020–0.030 A after you prompt to boot on DC Power Supply

claims.statement: iPhone 7 that draws nothing before power-on and hangs steadily at about 20–40 mA after usually has a cracked/loose coil above the CPU: L1801, L1804 or L3302.
Coil values: L1801 and L1804 are 1 µH 2.1 A 0.12 Ω; L3302 is 1.2 µH 3.0 A 0.080 Ω.
Underfill must be cleared before poking the coils; they sit against the CPU so careless hot air can float it.

procedure: Clear underfill around L1801, L1804, L3302.
Poke each coil; replace any that break off with correct values.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Hot air near these coils can float the CPU.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
